question_text: A father gives 8% of his monthly income to both his sons as pocket money. The elder son gets 85% of the total amount given to both the sons. He spends 90% of the amount and saves Rs 17. What is the monthly income of father?
explanation: Calculated: the elder son receives Rs. 17 / 0.10 = Rs. 170; total pocket money = 170 / 0.85 = Rs. 200, which is 8% of income, so income = Rs. 2,500.
